_comment: SOLARMAN alarms (UC22): thresholds and field names read by check_solarman_alarms.py.
SOLARMAN's own Alerts tab returned nothing for any of the four plants (Nov 2026), and the
readings carry no fault codes, so the alarms are made from the inverters' 5-minute history,
their live status and their silence, and handed to the six-hour gate.
The grid and backup thresholds are UC20's (config/must_telemetry.json) on purpose: one
rule for 'the grid is off' across every vendor.

battery_open._comment: An SRNE that has lost its battery reads SoC exactly 0 with its DC bus at about 470 V (370-416 V while the battery is on). A Deye-type reads its battery terminal near 0 V.

load._comment: A house on the inverter never draws under 50 W for six hours: the fridge alone is more. An SRNE whose house is on the manual changeover reads 10-16 W, its own meter's noise.

profiles._comment: Series names as SOLARMAN's day history writes them, matched with spaces collapsed and case ignored. Several names = several phases: voltages take the lowest phase.

products._comment: SOLARMAN productId -> profile. An inverter of any other product is still watched for silence and its alert tab, not for its readings.

rules_off._comment: Station id -> rules switched off for that plant, e.g. {"12345": ["load-off"]}. Rules: grid-loss, backup, battery-open, output-off, load-off, fault, silent, alert.
